responsibility: Defines the x86 SHA512 intrinsic interface for the SHA-512 message-schedule and round instructions. After enabling the `sha512` target feature, it exposes the 256-bit vector wrappers `_mm256_sha512msg1_epi64`, `_mm256_sha512msg2_epi64`, and `_mm256_sha512rnds2_epi64`, mapping the public API directly to the dedicated GCC SHA-512 builtins.
